Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.wmts

Class WmtsLayerManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.wmts.WmtsLayerManager
public class WmtsLayerManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Cascading WMTS Layer REST API manager.

A WMTS layer proxies a tile layer from an external WMTS server (or GeoWebCache) registered in a WMTS store and publishes it as a GeoServer layer. On publish, GeoServer calls CatalogBuilder.initWMTSLayer() automatically to set bbox and CRS.

    • listAvailable

      public List<String> listAvailable(String workspaceName, String storeName)
      Lists layer names available from the remote WMTS server that have not yet been published.

      Issues a real GetCapabilities HTTP request to the remote WMTS. If the capabilitiesURL is unreachable, GeoServer returns 500.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMTS store name (required)
      Returns:
      list of remote WMTS layer names not yet published (empty list if none)

    • publish

      public WmtsLayer publish(String workspaceName, String storeName, PublishWmtsLayerRequest request)
      Publishes a remote WMTS layer from a WMTS store.

      On publish, GeoServer calls CatalogBuilder.initWMTSLayer() automatically to set bbox and CRS. A GeoServer LayerInfo is also created automatically.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMTS store name (required)
      request - publish parameters (name + nativeName required)
      Returns:
      the published WMTS layer details
      Throws:
      ResourceAlreadyExistsException - if a WMTS layer with the same name already exists

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, String layerName)
      Deletes a WMTS layer. Uses recurse=false.

      Layers published via POST always have an associated LayerInfo. With recurse=false, returns 403 if a LayerInfo exists. Use delete(ws, store, layer, true) to cascade-delete the LayerInfo as well.

      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMTS store name (required)
      layerName - WMTS layer name to delete (required)
      Throws:
      WmtsLayerNotFoundException - if the layer does not exist (404)
      AuthenticationException - if a LayerInfo reference exists (403)

    • delete

      public void delete(String workspaceName, String storeName, String layerName, boolean recurse)
      Deletes a WMTS layer.
      Parameters:
      workspaceName - workspace name (required)
      storeName - WMTS store name (required)
      layerName - WMTS layer name to delete (required)
      recurse - when true, cascade-deletes associated LayerInfo; when false, returns 403 if a LayerInfo reference exists
      Throws:
      WmtsLayerNotFoundException - if the layer does not exist (404)
      AuthenticationException - when recurse=false and a LayerInfo reference exists (403)
